profile.headline: Software Engineer at Thermo Fisher Scientific
profile.summary:
- Seasoned software developer for scientific instruments
- Co-authored Accelerating MATLAB with GPU Computing (published by Elsevier)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the backup and port management utilities for InnoviGene Suite SW (Java, SpringBoot)
• Designed and developed embedded software for SeqStudioFlex Genetic Analyzer System (Android 8.0, Java, Debian12). Led 10+ developers including off-shore teams.
• Designed and developed embedded software from scratch for SeqStudio Genetic Analyzer System (Android 5.0, Java, Debian10). Led ~7 developers including off-shore teams.
• Maintains and adds new SW features for 3500 Series Genetic Analyzers (Java, Eclipse, Windows 10)
• Introduced and pioneered Android development for qPCR and sequencing  instruments.
• Developed real-time plot features for QuatStudio 3 Real-Time PCR System.*

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Refactored and improved the SOLiD 5500 imaging software (C++, Qt, Red Hat Linux, CUDA).
- Developed and improved software-based auto-exposure and autofocus algorithms
- Debugged complex multi-threaded machine control software and CUDA based algorithms
• Designed and developed software for QuantStudio 3D Digital PCR System.
- Implemented and integrated imaging algorithm pipelines using C++/OpenCV
- Designed and developed embedded GUI with Gtk

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and developed software from scratch for Ikonisys’ automated microscope system (C++, C#, .NET, Windows)
•  Led up to 7 developers
•  Authored software requirement and design specifications through constant interactions and
communication with scientists and stakeholders.
•  Helped the company acquire venture capital funds through rapid prototyping and feasibility
studies using VC++, Matrox Imaging Library and Matlab.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed and integrated image processing algorithms for medical CT images in DICOM.
•  Developed the 3D medical software that simulates a virtual implant surgery using C++, MFC, OpenGL, and OpenInventor.
•  Started as an internal R&D project (5 members) and finally spun off to 10dr.com
